hints: Find $a = S_1 = 5$ and $u_2 = S_2 - S_1 = 7 \implies d = 2$.
walkthrough:
Find the first term $a$ and common difference $d$ using $S_n = n^2 + 4n$:
$$a = S_1 = 1^2 + 4(1) = 5$$
$$S_2 = 2^2 + 4(2) = 12 \implies u_2 = S_2 - S_1 = 12 - 5 = 7$$
$$d = u_2 - u_1 = 7 - 5 = 2$$

Express the $k$th term $u_k$ using the formula $u_k = a + (k - 1)d$:
$$u_k = 5 + (k - 1)(2) = 2k + 3$$

Set up the inequality for the $k$th term exceeding $200$:
$$2k + 3 > 200 \implies 2k > 197 \implies k > 98.5$$

State the smallest integer value of $k$:
$$k = 99$$
